tmse_only_and_entropy_same_scope.rule: tMSE-only and Entropy reduction must each meet the same frozen scope

band_classification.negative: numerically guarded simultaneous upper endpoint is strictly below zero
band_classification.positive: numerically guarded simultaneous lower endpoint is strictly above zero
band_classification.unresolved: numerically guarded simultaneous band includes zero, including an endpoint exactly equal to zero

interpretation_rules.budget_robust_within_factor: terminal and assignment directions are each guarded-resolved consistently and are opposite at N=20, 40, and 80 for that c_sigma
interpretation_rules.calibration_robust_at_N40: terminal and assignment directions are each guarded-resolved consistently and are opposite at all three c_sigma values at N=40
interpretation_rules.finite_range_attenuation: Family-B N=20 penalty is guarded-positive and the matched Family-C interaction is guarded-negative over the evaluated N=20 to N=80 range
interpretation_rules.full_grid_robust: terminal and assignment directions are each guarded-resolved consistently and are opposite in all nine evaluated budget-by-c_sigma cells
prohibited_inferences: sameness from an interval that includes zero
behavior outside the three evaluated finite snapshots
a clinical enrollment requirement from per-stratum simulated enrollment
robustness to model errors outside the frozen toxicity-noise-SD perturbation
a four-policy ranking from the cEI shared-gate reference

secondary_interval_classification.negative: numerically guarded pointwise upper endpoint is strictly below zero
secondary_interval_classification.positive: numerically guarded pointwise lower endpoint is strictly above zero
secondary_interval_classification.unavailable: the frozen conditional diagnostic has no eligible denominator
secondary_interval_classification.unresolved: numerically guarded pointwise interval includes zero, including an endpoint exactly equal to zero

interpretation_rules.shared_gate_history_compatibility: Within one frozen factor-budget-metric cell, guarded-positive calibration penalties for all four policies together with unresolved guarded policy-vs-cEI differentials are compatible with shared-gate fragility; any guarded-resolved differential shows that policy-induced histories modify sensitivity

limitations: sameness from an interval that includes zero
behavior outside the three evaluated finite snapshots
a clinical enrollment requirement from per-stratum simulated enrollment
robustness to model errors outside the frozen toxicity-noise-SD perturbation
a four-policy ranking from the cEI shared-gate reference

primary.threshold_rule: all guarded_mcse_points <= threshold_points; top up the whole factorial from M=200 to 500 or from M=500 to 1000; at M=1000 stop and retain any rows over threshold

secondary.guarded_pointwise_interval_formula: guarded_low = raw_ci95_low - h; guarded_high = raw_ci95_high + h
secondary.guarded_scientific_sign_rule: positive iff guarded_low > 0; negative iff guarded_high < 0; otherwise unresolved, including an endpoint exactly equal to zero
secondary.unit: percentage points for panel_brier_score_pct; zero otherwise

reader_labels.c_sigma_axis: Assumed / true toxicity observation-noise SD, c_sigma
